goal.request: Independently test whether the katabasis_living_underworld_descent hard visual meaning survives one reference-conditioned image render, with no retry.

evidence.claim: The pre-render effective contract required living agency, a visible human-world origin, a bounded downward crossing, a distinct underworld destination, and a visible purpose token in one image.
The composed prompt passed fail-closed audit with every hard evidence phrase literal and negative_en preserved.
The final positive prompt contains all four frozen anchor phrases, all five profile evidence bindings, and a single-frame actor/action/target/consequence relation within the absolute word budget.
evidence.artifact: composed_prompt.json; composed_prompt_audit.json actual_words 258 and failures empty

evidence.claim: The exact native runtime prompt, reference path/hash/role, intent lock, and negative bytes passed runtime audit before generation.
The built-in image_gen tool delivered one saved PNG from one call with no retry.

At 256x320, the daylight origin, descending stair, living traveler, red cord, skeletal ferryman, dead inhabitants, astrolabe, and sparking chain are readable, but the traveler appears settled at the stair bottom rather than crossing a bounded threshold.
At 1122x1402 and in native crops, both boots occupy one lower landing with no gate-straddling descent; the ferryman's map tablet also carries malformed pseudo-lettering.
The render-review schema passed and derived one failed hard gate, vo_myth_katabasis_threshold.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: One still must simultaneously read as an alive and agentive visitor actively crossing downward from a retained human-world origin into a distinct realm of the dead while carrying a visible mission token.

invariants.statement: Living traveler, human-world origin, bounded downward threshold, underworld destination, and purpose token must all pass in the same pixels.
Only observable face-and-hair cues may continue from the source portrait; no same-person or identity conclusion is made.
causal_controls: adult appearance continuity without identity inference

mismatches.source_state: The prompt and profile require boots visibly straddling a bounded downward threshold during descent.
mismatches.render_state: Both boots are settled on the same lower landing; the stair is behind the traveler and no gate is being crossed.

mismatches.source_state: The objective is a cracked map tablet; no readable lettering is requested.
mismatches.render_state: The tablet prominently displays malformed pseudo-Latin glyphs.

hypotheses.statement: The generator preserved the stair topology and underworld relation but simplified the hardest transitional body geometry into a stable landing pose.
hypotheses.falsifier: An unchanged-prompt matched render would clearly place the two boots on opposite sides of a bounded gate while preserving all other hard relations.

hypotheses.statement: The tablet prop triggered an inscription prior even though no textual content was requested.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched render of the same audited prompt would preserve a plainly cracked map surface without pseudo-lettering.

intervention.general_rule: No skill or runtime rule was changed; this record preserves one motivating rendered evaluation for a future bounded repair.
intervention.generalization_basis: A single no-retry render can diagnose a local failure but cannot justify a reusable skill change or promotion.

decision.rationale: Prompt and runtime preflight passed, but the one saved render failed the bounded active downward crossing hard gate; four other profile gates passing cannot be combined into qualification, and user preference remains unscored.
